answer: Consider Proof of unique CVE authorship as the gate. With a vulnerability entry credited to one researcher in place, the ivory an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique CVE authorship asks for, so they pass without noticing; the kernel is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the comet is that the farm's unit economics never work.
